summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Diana Shipping Inc. reporting the adoption of an amended and restated Equity Incentive Plan by its Board of Directors effective April 29, 2026. The filing contains standard plan terms such as purpose, administration, eligibility, award types, and share limits. It includes no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing is an ordinary corporate governance update to a long-term incentive compensation plan for key persons, not a special situation.
